DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お手続きの連絡で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with contact about your procedure?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 口座の確認で折返し電話を待っています。職場では周りに聞こえるので、話せる時間を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 口座の照会で折返しを待っているが職場では周囲に聞こえるため、話せる時間を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am waiting for a callback about an account inquiry. People at work can overhear, so I would like to discuss a time when I can speak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are waiting for a callback about an account inquiry but people can overhear at work, so you want to discuss a time to speak. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ、連絡できる時間の希望を伝えられます。いつなら落ち着いてお話しできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can tell the person in charge your preferred contact time. When can you talk comfortably?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事が終わるのは18時です。18時半なら静かな場所で話せます。休憩中に取れても、口座番号を周りで読み上げることは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕事は18時に終わり18時半なら静かな場所で話せると伝え、休憩中でも口座番号を周囲に読み上げないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I finish work at 6 p.m. At 6:30 I can talk somewhere quiet. Even if I answer during a break, I want to avoid reading out my account number around others.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that work ends at 6 p.m. and you can talk somewhere quiet at 6:30, and that even during a break you will not read your account number aloud around others. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人が話せる環境で確認しましょう。着信した時に出られなければ、案内された連絡先で折返し方法を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us arrange verification where you can speak yourself. If you cannot answer the call, check the callback method using the contact details provided.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同僚に代わりに内容を聞いてもらうのはやめます。連絡のあった時刻だけメモして、自分で担当へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同僚に照会内容を代わりに聞いてもらわず、着信時刻を記録して自分で担当者へ連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not have a colleague hear the details on my behalf. I will note only the call time and contact the person in charge myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not have a colleague hear the inquiry details for you, will record the call time, and contact the person in charge yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それがご希望ですね。留守番電話についても、必要な案内方法を担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is your preference. You can also discuss the necessary instructions for voicemail with the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 詳しい口座情報を残してほしいのではなく、担当の連絡先と折返し方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 留守番電話に詳細な口座情報は残さず、担当者の連絡先と折返し方法の案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not want detailed account information left in voicemail. I want to confirm the staff contact details and how to call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for voicemail to provide staff contact details and callback instructions without leaving detailed account information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、今日は18時半に折り返すという回答が来ました。留守番電話には口座の詳細を残さず、連絡が必要な場合はお渡しした案内の連絡先と折返し方法だけを使う、という希望も記録しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge has replied that they will call back at 6:30 p.m. today. I have also recorded your wish that no account details be left in voicemail and that, if contact is needed, only the contact details and callback method in the guide we gave you be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は18時半に静かな場所で私が電話を受けます。案内の連絡先は手元に置き、詳しい口座情報は留守番電話や同僚への伝言に残さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 18時半の折返しを静かな場所で本人が受け、案内の連絡先を手元に置き、口座の詳細は留守番電話や同僚への伝言に残さないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will answer myself somewhere quiet at 6:30 today. I will keep the guide's contact details with me. Please do not leave detailed account information in voicemail or messages with colleagues.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will personally answer the 6:30 callback somewhere quiet, keep the provided contact details with you, and ask that account details not be left in voicemail or with colleagues. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 18時半の折返しと、詳しい情報を伝言に残さない希望を確認しました。取引の確認自体が終わったわけではありませんので、その内容は担当と直接お話しください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the 6:30 callback and your wish to leave no detailed information in messages. The transaction inquiry itself is not complete, so please discuss it directly with the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。商品選びで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you choose a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 作り置きを温める容器を探しています。熱い物を入れられる表示と、電子レンジで使える表示を分けて見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 作り置きを温める容器が必要なので、熱い食品を入れる条件と電子レンジの使用条件を分けて確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for a container to reheat prepared meals. I want to check separately the label for holding hot food and the label for microwave use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you need a container for reheating prepared meals and want to check hot-food conditions separately from microwave-use conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使う時はふたも一緒に温めたいですか。商品の使用方法を比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you want to heat the lid along with the container? Let us compare the product instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ふた付きで持って行きますが、温める時の扱いは表示を読みます。本体とふたを同じ条件と決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参時はふたをするが加熱時は表示に従い、本体とふたを同じ条件だとは判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will carry it with the lid on, but I will read the label about what to do when heating. I will not assume the body and lid have the same conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will cover it for carrying but follow the heating label, without assuming the body and lid have the same conditions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 部品ごとの案内を確認してください。料理は何人分入れる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the instructions for each part. How many portions do you plan to put in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の一食分です。大きい容器なら便利と思いましたが、職場の置き場所に入る寸法も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の一食分を入れ、大きさだけで選ばず職場の置き場所に収まる寸法も確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One meal for myself. I thought a large container would be convenient, but I want to check dimensions that fit my storage space at work too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will put in one meal for yourself and want to check dimensions that fit your workplace storage space rather than choose by size alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 容量と外寸を比べられます。持ち運ぶ時のふたの閉め方も商品ごとに確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can compare capacity and outside dimensions. Please also check each product's lid-closing instructions for transport.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 汁のある料理も考えていました。でも密閉という名前だけで、横に倒しても漏れないとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 汁物も考えているが、密閉という名称だけで横倒しでも漏れないとは判断しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I was considering food with liquid too. But I will not assume the name 'airtight' means it will not leak if laid on its side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are considering food with liquid but will not assume an 'airtight' name guarantees no leaks when laid sideways. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 用途に合う表示を読み、持ち運び方も考えて選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Read labels suited to your purpose and consider how you will carry it when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本体とふたの温め方、外寸、持ち運びの条件を確認して選びます。一食分に合うものを探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本体とふたの加熱条件、外寸、持運び条件を確認して一食分に合う容器を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose after checking how to heat the body and lid, the outside dimensions, and transport conditions. I will look for one suitable for a single meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check heating conditions for the body and lid, outside dimensions and transport conditions to choose a container for one meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。表示をご一緒に確認しましょう。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Let us check the labels together. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園の案内で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with park information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と別々に見て回ります。友人の携帯の電池が少ないので、電話なしでも合流できる約束を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人と別行動するが携帯の電池が少ないため、電話なしでも合流できる約束を決めたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend and I will look around separately. Their phone battery is low, so I want to agree on how to meet even without calling.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about agreeing how to meet without phone calls when you and your friend split up and the phone battery is low. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの目印を使う予定ですか。二人で確認できる場所でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which landmark do you plan to use? Is it somewhere you can both check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の案内板を二人で見ました。同じ入口の名前も確認したので、そこを候補にしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 入口の案内板と入口名を二人で確かめたので、その場所を候補にしていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We both looked at the information board at the entrance. We confirmed the same entrance name, so that is our candidate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you both checked the entrance information board and name, so you are considering that place. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口が複数ある場合も、名前まで合えばわかりやすいですね。合流する時刻は決めましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even with several entrances, agreeing on the name makes it clearer. Have you set a meeting time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時計で三時と決めます。お互いの時計が同じか今見て、携帯が切れてから時刻を探さないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三時に会うと決めて時計を照合し、携帯の電池が切れる前に時刻を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will agree on three o'clock by our watches. We will compare them now so we do not have to figure out the time after the phone battery dies.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will meet at three, compare your watches, and confirm the time before the phone battery dies. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 約束の場所で待つ方法も相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also discuss how you will wait at the agreed place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 遅れたら十分は同じ場所で待ちます。待っている間に相手を探しに動くと行き違うので、動かない約束にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 遅れたら同じ場所で十分待ち、待っている間に探しに動いて行き違わない約束をすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If one is late, we will wait in the same place for ten minutes. Moving around to search could make us miss each other, so we will agree to stay put while waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait in the same place for ten minutes if someone is late, without moving to search and missing each other. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お互い確認してから別行動にしましょう。現在の利用案内も見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Confirm together before splitting up. Please check the current park-use guidance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口名と案内板、三時、待つ時間を復唱します。電話が使えなくても同じ場所へ戻れるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口名、案内板、三時、待機時間を復唱し、電話が使えなくても同じ場所へ戻れるようにすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will repeat the entrance name, information board, three o'clock, and waiting time. We will make sure we can return to the same place even without our phones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will repeat the entrance name, information board, three o'clock and waiting time so you can return to the same place even without phones. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。約束を確認して、楽しくお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01234-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Confirm your agreement and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。移動の予定で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your travel plan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会場の受付に10時15分までに着きたいです。この時刻表で、バスと列車を乗り継げば間に合うか計算を手伝ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会場受付10時15分までに着くため、バスと列車の時刻表で間に合うか計算を手伝ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to reach the venue's reception by 10:15 a.m. Please help me calculate from this timetable whether I can make it by connecting from bus to train.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help calculating from bus and train timetables whether you can reach venue reception by 10:15 a.m. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 選んだバスと列車を見せてください。乗り物に乗る時間だけでなく、徒歩と待つ時間も入れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the bus and train you selected. Have you included walking and waiting time, not only the time on board?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 9時のバスが9時20分に着き、駅へ歩いて10分、列車には30分乗ります。全部で60分と思っていましたが、待つ時間は入れていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 9時のバスは9時20分着で徒歩10分、列車30分を合計60分と思ったが待ち時間は入れていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The 9 a.m. bus arrives at 9:20, then it is ten minutes' walk to the station and thirty minutes on the train. I thought the total was sixty minutes, but I left out waiting time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the 9 a.m. bus arrives at 9:20 with ten minutes' walk and thirty minutes on the train, which you totaled as sixty minutes without waiting time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 駅に着くのは9時30分ですが、その列車は9時55分発です。待ち時間は25分ですね。列車の到着は10時25分なので、受付10時15分より遅くなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: You reach the station at 9:30, but that train leaves at 9:55, so there is a 25-minute wait. The train arrives at 10:25, later than reception at 10:15.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 25分待つのを忘れていました。到着駅から会場へも徒歩20分あるので、この候補では10時45分ですね。もっと早いバスの組合せを見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅で待つ25分を忘れ、到着駅から徒歩20分も必要なので会場10時45分となると確認し、早いバスの候補を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I forgot the 25-minute wait. There is also a twenty-minute walk from the arrival station to the venue, so this option reaches it at 10:45. I would like to look at an earlier bus connection.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you forgot the 25-minute wait and need another twenty-minute walk, making venue arrival 10:45, and ask about an earlier bus option. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 早い候補は8時30分のバスで8時50分着、徒歩10分で駅に9時です。9時10分の列車が9時40分に着きます。会場まで歩く20分を足すと何時でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: An earlier option is the 8:30 bus arriving at 8:50, then ten minutes' walk reaches the station at 9. The 9:10 train arrives at 9:40. What time is it after adding twenty minutes' walk to the venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 10時です。列車が到着する9時40分を会場到着と思わず、徒歩20分を足しました。受付まで15分の余裕があります。早い方を予定にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 早い候補の列車到着9時40分に徒歩20分を足すと会場10時で受付まで15分余裕があり、早い方を予定にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ten o'clock. I added the twenty-minute walk rather than treating the train's 9:40 arrival as venue arrival. That leaves fifteen minutes before reception. I would like to plan for the earlier option.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that adding twenty minutes' walk to the earlier train's 9:40 arrival makes venue arrival 10 a.m., with fifteen minutes to spare, and you want the earlier option. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、計算上は8時30分のバスから、駅で10分待って9時10分の列車、会場10時です。これはこの時刻表に基づく予定で、遅延や道の状況で変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, the calculation is the 8:30 bus, a ten-minute station wait, the 9:10 train and venue arrival at 10. This plan is based on this timetable and may change with delays or road conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 8時30分のバスと9時10分の列車を候補にし、会場10時、受付まで15分と控えました。二つの徒歩区間と待ち時間を入れ、出発前に利用便の案内も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 8時30分のバスと9時10分の列車、会場10時で余裕15分と控え、徒歩二区間と待ち時間を入れて出発前の運行案内も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I noted the 8:30 bus and 9:10 train as options, venue arrival at 10, and fifteen minutes to spare. I included both walking sections and waiting time, and will check the service information before departure too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you noted the 8:30 bus, 9:10 train, venue arrival at 10 and fifteen minutes to spare, included two walks and waiting time, and will check service information before departure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 計算と選んだ候補の確認ができました。受付期限と、実際に利用する交通の最新案内もご確認ください。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have confirmed the calculation and your selected option. Please also check the reception deadline and latest information for the actual transport you use. Travel safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。住まいの相談で何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with housing advice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋の換気扇が動かなくなりました。修理の連絡先と費用の相談先を整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋の換気扇が動かなくなったので、修理の連絡先と費用の相談先を整理したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My room's ventilation fan has stopped working. I want to clarify whom to contact for repairs and whom to consult about costs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your room's ventilation fan stopped working and you want to clarify repair contacts and advice about costs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 契約書に管理者や修理の連絡先はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your contract list a manager or repair contact?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 管理会社の番号があります。家賃を送っている口座の相手と、修理担当が同じとは限らないので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書に管理会社の番号があり、家賃の振込先と修理担当が同じとは限らないので確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has the management company's number. I want to check because the recipient account for rent and the repair contact are not necessarily the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the contract lists the management company's number and you want to check because the rent recipient and repair contact are not necessarily the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 設備の状況はまず管理者へ伝えられます。費用の扱いは契約や相談先で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can first tell the manager about the equipment's condition. Check how costs are handled in your contract or with the advice service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 故障の写真と、いつ気づいたかを用意します。自分で修理を頼んで請求すればよいと決めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 写真と気づいた日時を用意し、自分で業者を手配して後から請求できるとは決めつけないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will prepare photos of the fault and when I noticed it. I have not assumed I can arrange repairs myself and then ask for reimbursement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will prepare photos and the time you noticed the fault, without assuming you can hire a repairer yourself and bill afterward. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 依頼する前に、管理者の対応方法を聞きましょう。契約書も確認できるよう持参してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Before requesting repairs, ask how the manager handles them. Please bring the contract so it can be checked too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 設備を使えるかも管理者へ聞きます。見た目だけで安全と言わず、案内があるまで無理に使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 設備を使ってよいか管理者に尋ね、外見だけで安全と判断せず案内まで無理に使わないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also ask the manager whether I can use the equipment. I will not call it safe based only on appearance or force myself to use it before receiving instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask the manager whether the equipment may be used and will not judge it safe by appearance or force its use before instructions. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 不安な状態を具体的に知らせてください。住まいの相談窓口も担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please describe specifically what concerns you. The person in charge will also check the housing advice desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 写真、日時、契約の連絡先を整理します。修理依頼と費用の扱いを別に聞き、先に支払いを約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真、日時、契約の連絡先を整理し、修理依頼と費用負担を別に尋ね、先に支払いを約束しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will organize the photos, dates and contract contact details. I will ask separately about arranging repairs and responsibility for costs, without promising payment first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will organize photos, dates and contract contacts, ask separately about repairs and cost responsibility, and not promise payment in advance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談先を確認してご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the advice service and guide you. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 症状を母語でメモしてきました。日本語の説明に自信がないので、医療の担当へ見せる方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 症状を母語で書いたが日本語の説明に自信がないので、医療者へメモを示す方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote my symptoms in my native language. I am not confident explaining in Japanese, so I would like advice on showing the note to medical staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you wrote your symptoms in your native language but lack confidence explaining in Japanese, and ask how to show the note to medical staff. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモには日時や症状を書いていますか。読みやすい形で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does your note include times and symptoms? Can you show it in a readable form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 始まった日と、仕事中に起きたことを書きました。日本語にした一行はありますが、意味が合うか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発症日と仕事中の出来事を書き、日本語の一行もあるが意味が合うか不安だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote the date it began and what happened at work. There is also one line in Japanese, but I am unsure whether the meaning matches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the onset date and what happened at work and have one Japanese line, but are unsure its meaning matches. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元のメモと日本語の文を分けて、担当へ伝えてください。説明の補助方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please present the original note and Japanese sentence separately to the person in charge. We will also check ways to support your explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ言葉で痛みとだるさをまとめてしまいました。担当に、どんな感じか質問してもらって説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 痛みとだるさを一語にまとめてしまったので、医療者に具体的な感じを質問してもらいたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I combined pain and fatigue into the same word. I would like the person in charge to ask what they feel like so I can explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you combined pain and fatigue into one word and want medical staff to ask you about the specific sensations. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 具体的な感じや変化を医療者へ伝えましょう。時刻の書き方も確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the medical staff the specific sensations and changes. We can also check how the time is written.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 10月1日から2日にかけての夜勤で、夜中の1時です。日本語のメモには10月1日午後1時と書いてしまったので、10月2日午前1時に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夜勤は10月1日から2日で、メモの10月1日午後1時を10月2日午前1時に直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was at 1 a.m. during the night shift spanning October 1 and 2. I mistakenly wrote 1 p.m. on October 1 in the Japanese note, so I want to correct it to 1 a.m. on October 2.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the night shift spanned October 1 and 2 and you want to correct October 1 at 1 p.m. in the note to October 2 at 1 a.m. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 日付と時刻を10月2日午前1時に直しました。元の母語メモは別に残しています。「痛み」と「だるさ」の感じは、医療担当がご本人へ確認できるよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have corrected the date and time to October 2 at 1 a.m. The original native-language note remains separate. I will tell the medical staff to check the sensations of pain and fatigue directly with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 10月2日午前1時になっていますね。母語のメモも渡します。痛みとだるさを一つにまとめず、担当の質問に具体的に答えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正後の10月2日午前1時を確認し、母語メモも示して痛みとだるさを区別する医療担当の質問に答えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: It now says October 2 at 1 a.m. I will also hand over my native-language note. Rather than combine pain and fatigue, I want to answer the staff's questions specifically.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the corrected October 2 at 1 a.m., show the native-language note too, and say you want to answer medical staff's questions to distinguish pain and fatigue. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。説明の希望を担当へ伝えます。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will tell the person in charge how you would like to explain. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What seems to be the problem?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐車した車の窓が開いていました。自分で閉め忘れたのか、何かあったのか、わかることを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 駐車した車の窓が開いているが原因は不明なので、分かる事実を報告したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The window of my parked car was open. I do not know whether I forgot to close it or something happened, so I want to report what I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your parked car's window is open but the cause is unknown, so you want to report the facts you know. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 車を停めた時刻と、窓を最後に確認した時はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know when you parked and when you last checked the window?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 停めたのは午前中です。窓を閉めた記憶は曖昧なので、誰かが開けたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午前中に駐車したが閉めた記憶は曖昧で、誰かが開けたとは言えないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I parked in the morning. My memory of closing the window is vague, so I cannot say someone opened it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you parked in the morning but do not clearly remember closing the window, so you cannot say someone opened it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在わかる状態を説明してください。車内の物に変化はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe the condition you currently know. Has anything inside the car changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 置いていた袋はあります。中身はまだ確認していないので、何もなくなっていないとは断言しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車内の袋はあるが中身は未確認なので、何もなくなっていないとは断言しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The bag I left is there. I have not checked its contents yet, so I cannot say for certain that nothing is missing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that the bag is in the car but its contents are unchecked, so you cannot assert that nothing is missing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できた事実と未確認を分けましょう。近くの管理者へ状況を伝えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us separate confirmed facts from unchecked matters. Have you told the nearby manager about the situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。見守りの記録があるか聞きたいですが、自分で他人の記録を見せろと要求せず、担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理者には未連絡で記録の有無を聞きたいが、自分で閲覧を要求せず担当者に相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I want to ask whether there are monitoring records, but I will consult the person in charge rather than demand access to other people's records myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not contacted the manager and want to ask whether records exist, but will consult the person in charge without demanding access yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 記録の照会方法も含め担当が確認します。現在の安全に不安があれば知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check how to inquire about records too. Please tell us if you are worried about your current safety.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 停めた時刻、開いた窓、袋はあることを伝えます。閉めた記憶と中身は未確認で、記録は担当へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駐車時刻、開いた窓、袋の存在を示し、閉めた記憶と中身は未確認として記録照会を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will report the parking time, open window and presence of the bag. My memory of closing it and the contents are unconfirmed, and I will consult about records with the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report the parking time, open window and bag's presence, say your memory of closing it and the contents are unconfirmed, and ask about record inquiries. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類の発送で何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you send your documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 資料の三ページ目が机に残っていました。まだ荷物を預けていないので、一緒に入れ直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 資料の三ページ目を入れ忘れ、まだ荷物は預けていないので入れ直したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The third page of my documents was left on the desk. I have not handed over the parcel yet, so I want to reopen it and include the page.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot page three and have not handed over the parcel, so you want to put it in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封は済んでいますか。何ページの資料でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you sealed it? How many pages are the documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 封をしましたが、まだ自分で持っています。五ページで、今は一、二、四、五だけ入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封をした五ページの資料を手元で持っており、今は一、二、四、五ページだけ入っていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I sealed it but still have it with me. There are five pages, and only pages one, two, four and five are inside now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you still have the sealed five-page document package, but only pages one, two, four and five are currently inside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で開け直し、順序を確認してから準備できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can reopen it yourself and check the order before preparing it again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三ページ目だけ別便にせず、全部を一つにします。ページ番号を一から五まで読んでそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 三ページ目を別便にせず、一から五まで番号を照合して全て一緒に送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put everything together rather than send page three separately. I will read and match the page numbers one through five.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check page numbers one through five and send everything together rather than send page three separately. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかに同封する物はありますか。内容の一覧も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything else to enclose? Please also check the contents list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 返信用の紙があります。資料のページに数えず、一覧の別項目として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信用の紙は資料のページ数に含めず、同封物一覧の別項目として確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a reply sheet. I will not count it as a document page; I will check it as a separate item on the enclosure list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will not count the reply sheet in the document page total, but check it as a separate item on the enclosure list. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書類と同封物を分けて確認できますね。封筒が破れたら新しい物を用意してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then you can check documents and enclosures separately. Prepare a new envelope if the old one tears.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 五ページと返信用の紙を一覧で確認し、新しい封筒に入れます。そろってから一つの発送としてお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 五ページと返信用の紙を確認して新しい封筒へ入れ、全てそろった一通として発送を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the five pages and reply sheet against the list and put them in a new envelope. Once all are together, please send them as one package.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the five pages and reply sheet, put them in a new envelope, and request one shipment containing everything. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。準備ができましたら受付へお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it to reception when ready. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。振込みのことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行費を同行者へ返します。立て替えてもらった分と、まだ払っていない予約分が混ざるので、金額を確かめてから振り込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者が立て替えた旅行費と未払いの予約が混ざるため、返す額を決めてから振り込みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am reimbursing a travel companion. The expenses they advanced and reservations not yet paid are mixed together, so I want to confirm the amount before transferring it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your companion's advanced travel costs and unpaid reservations are mixed together, so you want to decide the reimbursement amount before transferring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同行者から、立替えの明細はもらっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you received an itemized statement of the expenses your companion advanced?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宿の支払い明細があります。別の予約はまだ支払い前なので、そこまで返す金額に足していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿の支払い明細はあるが別予約は未払いで、その金額まで返済額に加えていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the accommodation payment statement. Another reservation is still unpaid, but I had added that amount to the reimbursement too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the accommodation payment statement but another reservation is unpaid, and you had added even that amount to the reimbursement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この宿の明細は二人分で一万二千円、二人で半分ずつ負担すると書かれています。未払いの予約は別なので、今回返す宿代はあなたの分の六千円として同行者に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This accommodation statement is for two people at 12,000 yen, to be shared equally. The unpaid reservation is separate, so you can confirm with your companion that this reimbursement is your 6,000-yen share of accommodation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宿の自分の分だけを今回返します。未払いの予約は、誰が払うか決まってから別に整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今回は宿の自分の負担分だけ返し、未払い予約は支払う人が決まってから整理すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will reimburse only my share of the accommodation this time. I will organize the unpaid reservation separately after deciding who will pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will reimburse only your accommodation share this time and organize the unpaid reservation after deciding who pays. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回確認する額は宿代の六千円、未払いの予約は含めない、という整理ですね。受取先の情報は同行者本人から届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: So the amount to confirm this time is 6,000 yen for accommodation, excluding the unpaid reservation. Did the recipient details come directly from your companion?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人のメッセージがあります。前の旅行で使った別の人の登録先を選ばず、今回の情報と見比べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今回の口座情報は本人のメッセージで確認し、前の旅行の別人の登録先を選ばないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have their message. I will compare it with this trip's information instead of choosing a different person's saved recipient from a previous trip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm this trip's account details in your companion's own message and not select a different person's saved recipient from the previous trip. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今回確認するのは、宿代一万二千円を二人で半分ずつ負担するうち、ご本人分の六千円です。未払い予約は含めない、と確認メモにしました。受取先は今回の同行者のメッセージと照合し、前の旅行の別人の登録先は選ばないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: This time we are confirming your 6,000-yen share of the 12,000-yen accommodation bill split equally between two people. I noted that the unpaid reservation is excluded. Compare the recipient details with this companion's message and do not choose the other person's saved details from the previous trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宿の自分の分を同行者と確認し、今回の受取先へ送ります。未払い予約と古い登録先を混ぜません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宿の自分の分を同行者と確認して今回の受取先へ送り、未払い予約と古い登録先は混同しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm my accommodation share with my companion and send it to the recipient for this trip. I will not mix in the unpaid reservation or old saved recipient.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm your accommodation share with your companion and send to this trip's recipient without confusing unpaid reservations or old recipient details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。操作でお困りでしたら担当へご相談ください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult the person in charge if you need help with the operation. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。商品探しで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you find a product?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家の洗剤の詰替えを探しています。ボトルの写真があるので、同じ種類か見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗剤の詰替えを探しているので、自宅のボトル写真と同じ種類か確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for a refill for the detergent at home. I have a photo of the bottle. Could you check whether it is the same type?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check whether a detergent refill is the same type as the bottle photographed at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真の品名と、手に取った袋の品名を比べましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us compare the product name in the photo with the name on the bag you picked up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 色は似ていますが、写真は食器用で、この袋は別の用途でした。色だけで選びかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 色は似ているが写真は食器用で選んだ袋は別用途だったので、色だけで選びかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The colors are similar, but the photo is dishwashing detergent and this bag was for a different purpose. I nearly chose by color alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the colors are similar, but the photographed product is for dishes while the chosen bag is for another use, and you nearly chose by color alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 用途と商品名を確認してください。詰替えの案内も商品ごとに見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the purpose and product name. Check the refill instructions for each product too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 食器用の棚を見直します。今のボトルへ入れられる品か、メーカーの表示で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食器用の売場を見直し、今のボトルへ詰め替えられるかメーカーの表示で確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will look again at the dishwashing section. I want to check the manufacturer's label to see whether it can refill my current bottle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will recheck the dishwashing section and the manufacturer's label to confirm compatibility with your current bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示に合う品を選び、違う種類を混ぜないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Choose a product matching the label and do not mix different types.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今の中身がどれくらい残るかも家で確認します。違う物を足して量だけそろえるのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今の中身が残っている量も確認し、違う洗剤を加えて量だけ合わせることはしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also check at home how much is left inside. I will not add a different product merely to bring the amount up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check how much remains and will not add a different detergent merely to increase the quantity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 詰替えの扱いは商品の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please follow the product's instructions for refilling.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-01235-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
